prompt: I've got five deep-research reports in ~/Dev/fledgeling-plugins/plugins/dossier-report/docs/deep-research/ — they're a panel run on how newsrooms build evidence-dense scrollytelling reports. Turn them into a single published page. Write it into the output directory you've been given, laid out exactly as it would sit in ~/Dev/dossier/<slug>/index.html, but do NOT write anything into ~/Dev/dossier/ itself. It should be self-contained HTML, everything cited, and it needs to look like something a person designed rather than a template.
assertions: An index.html exists in the output directory and is a complete standalone HTML document
scripts/audit_page.py reports 0 errors against the produced page
Both marketing blocks are present: a sticky masthead (.colophon) and a closing band (.closer), each linking to Dossier and Margin
Every data-cite anchor resolves to a listed source, and every listed source is cited at least once
A prefers-reduced-motion branch is present and disables or replaces motion rather than only shortening it
Share and identity tags are complete: title, description, og:title, og:image and canonical
The page carries a methods note naming which research backends produced the corpus
The headline states a finding rather than naming a topic, so the conclusion is legible in the first screenful
